verdict.rationale: A pricing-page tagline claims 'Build AI-powered audiences from a complete customer view,' suggesting some AI-assisted audience creation exists, and Audiences are built from tracking events/traits/computed traits tied to the actual schema. However, there is no documentation describing a natural-language input, an AI-generated segment definition for review, or how it maps to the underlying schema. Missing for 10: docs/UI evidence of natural-language audience description, generated definition preview/review step, and grounding mechanics against the customer schema.
